hypotheses: LY-294002 at 10 uM for 24 h in A375 produces a reproducible histone perturbation with log2 changes >0.5 in H3K27 methylation/acetylation states, consistent with PI3K inhibition altering chromatin-modifying enzyme activity.

Donors with high anchor similarity and known epigenetic or chromatin-modifying pharmacology (EPZ004777, EPZ-5676, GSK525762A) may transfer target-minus-A375 responses that recapitulate the H3K27me1K36me1 and H3K27me0K36me2 decreases.

Etoposide and resveratrol, despite lower structural similarity, may share downstream histone modification effects through DNA damage or sirtuin-related mechanisms, providing alternative donor responses for the observed H3K27 mark changes.
